description:
Create a validated EU e-invoice (UBL 2.1) from simple JSON. invoice = {format: en16931|xrechnung|peppol-bis3, invoice_number,
issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), due_date?, tax_point_date?, delivery_date?, currency (EUR), buyer_reference?, seller: {name, vat_id, street, city,
postal_code, country, email, phone, contact_name, company_id?, company_id_scheme?, legal_form?}, buyer: {...}, lines: [{description, quantity, unit_price, unit?, vat_category (S|Z|E|AE|K|G|O), vat_rate}],
payment: {iban, bic?, terms?}}. Totals and VAT breakdown are computed; returns {valid, xml, totals, errors, fixes}. autofix=true
applies the safe fixes (date formats, codes, VAT ID format, misnamed fields) first and returns the corrected input in autofix.invoice.

autofix.description: If true, first apply safe input fixes (date formats, codes, VAT ID format, misnamed fields); the corrected input is in autofix.invoice.
autofix.title: Autofix

invoice.description: Invoice as simple JSON: format, invoice_number, issue_date, currency, seller, buyer, lines, payment (see the tool description).
invoice.title: Invoice
